cohort: The study included fifty ventilator-dependent neonatal intensive care unit patients who underwent tracheotomy from 2009 to 2018.
finding: Tracheostomy placement in ventilator-dependent infants with high ventilator settings was found to be safe and effective, with no additional short-term risks compared to those with low ventilator settings.
followup_time: 7 days after tracheostomy; until hospital discharge
